correctness.checked_sources: Pinned RESULT.md/verify.py, exact edge-space rank computations
correctness.rationale: At order d-2 the derivative generators are e2 on every r-subset. Four-cycle edge relations leave an n-dimensional quotient; rank determinant -L*c gives the four quadratic spans. For L=0 a linear change x_i=y_i+t identifies equal-pair quadratic ideal I_m and, in characteristic two exceptional case, the monic t^2+P relation. The graded normal-form/evaluation calculation makes I_m radical (m axes plus diagonal), one-dimensional CM; adjoining free coordinate t yields reduced planes, and the monic quadratic extension over the reduced one-dimensional CM base is dimension-one CM with n curvilinear double projective points. No embedded associated primes. Independently checked 45 modular span-rank cases.
residual_risks: Finite-field support alone cannot determine nonreduced scheme structure; proof supplies ideal and CM analysis.
